Related file outside this directory:
  playground/coi-serviceworker.js (1,608 bytes)
    Isolation worker for this page: serves /playground/ with COOP/COEP so the
    engine's pthreads are legal on static hosts, written for this harness and
    adapted from coi-serviceworker v0.1.7, MIT, by Guido Zuidhof and
    contributors, https://github.com/gzuidhof/coi-serviceworker (that file:
    sha256 e97bbac6017322d48aa54a5bc7ce473c725a4b7376ff245002e0ba71c3dcdd7e).
    It lives at /playground/ (not here) because a service worker may only
    control URLs inside its own directory, and it must control this page.
    Unlike the stock coi worker it sets CORP same-origin on same-origin
    responses so the Emscripten pthread worker scripts pass the embedder
    policy checks.

Notes:
- This package version ships no separate worker/JS glue file: the Emscripten
  glue (z3-built.js) is a MODULARIZE build that exposes a global `initZ3`
  factory and locates z3-built.wasm next to itself via document.currentScript.
- The CommonJS wrappers (package/build/browser.js, high-level/, low-level/)
  need a bundler and are not vendored; the playground calls the exported Z3 C
  API on the Emscripten module directly instead.
- Nothing here may be fetched from a CDN at runtime; the build verifier
  enforces zero external runtime URLs. Files are byte-identical to the
  tarball contents.
